title: TraCT: Disaggregated LLM Serving with CXL Shared Memory KV Cache at Rack-Scale
technique: CXL shared memory as RDMA-free KV transfer substrate between prefill and decode workers and as rack-wide prefix-aware KV cache; software locks/flush for non-coherent CXL (on Dynamo+vLLM)

optimized_metrics.evidence: This network hop significantly inflates prefill latency, increases tail variability, and constrains overall throughput.
This network hop significantly inflates prefill latency, increases tail variability, and constrains overall throughput.

headline_claim.text: TraCT reduces average TTFT by up to 9.8x, lowers P99 latency by up to 6.2x, and improves peak throughput by up to 1.6x compared to RDMA and DRAM-based caching baselines.

reported_metrics.where: Fig 6, 7 (req/s; prefill throughput vs request throughput)
Fig 10 per-request time breakdown (schedule, kv_read, compute, kv_write)

metric_definitions.definition_quote: TraCT reduces and stabilizes TTFT (prefill latency).
metric_definitions.notes: TTFT used interchangeably with prefill latency; includes scheduler queue wait ('Scheduling time reflects how long a request waits in the scheduler's queue') per Fig 10 breakdown. Static workloads fix output length at 3 tokens so TTFT ~ end-to-end.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: at the tail (P99), it is reduced by up to 6.2x
metric_definitions.notes: Abstract says 'P99 latency'; intro and §5.3 clarify P99 TTFT. Not formally defined.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: Figure 6 evaluates both prefill and end-to-end request throughput under increasing QPS for 6000-token inputs.

load_regime: QPS sweep (1.0-3.0 for synthetic workloads; 0.5-1.5 for static 6000-token inputs); static fixed-length and synthetic Dynamo-generated workloads
hardware: 2 servers, NVIDIA A6000 48GB each; Niagara 2.0 CXL Type-3 device (640 ns, 10.1 GB/s); 100 Gbps NIC baseline
workloads: static (1500-6000 input tokens, 3 output tokens) and 3 synthetic workloads A/B/C from Dynamo data generator
extractor_notes: Prefill-side TTFT dominated evaluation; output length is 3 tokens in static runs so decode metrics (TPOT/TBT) are not studied. Abstract 'P99 latency' is P99 TTFT in the body. | TAIL AUDIT 2026-10-06: demoted TTFT@P99 (non-tail entry kept)

tail_audit.correction: Demote TTFT P99 'objective' to headline/reported. Tail variability appears only as motivation for removing the RDMA hop.
